svg.text: For avalanche terrain, HOW matters most: the model sees the ground, not the snow a skier stands on.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drifts, cornices and wind slabs reshape slopes every winter, and none of that is in a bare-earth DEM. Your report has to say so.
